My alt was banned for ban evading after he got this account was perm banned for combat logging. Hello,

My apologies for the long wait, appeal will be forwarded to the staff member who punished you.

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello Bob_Treebark,

I apologize for the long wait, however please be aware that your account is your responsibility. If you trust your friend with your account, then you are responsible for what happens. Therefore, this appeal is denied.

I will leave this appeal open for a senior staff member to review or for you to leave any questions. 

Thank you for your appeal and I apologize for the wait once again.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez
